title: API keys for your organization
summary: Organization API keys in Settings, a privacy consent step at sign-up, a Pricing link and cleaner CSV imports.

items.body: Create, list and revoke organization API keys in **Settings → API keys**
Sign-up now asks you to agree to the privacy policy
A **Pricing** item in the sidebar opens plans and top-ups
Term base and glossary CSVs keep Hindi and other Indic text intact
Term base CSV cells import exactly as written
Social sign-in buttons reset after an abandoned sign-in
